    {
      "step": 1,
      "text": "For this vegetable dish boil {{ing_01|bulbs}} [3] [in] {{ing_02|broth}}, {{ing_03|oil}}, and {{ing_04|wine}}."
    },
    {
      "step": 2,
      "text": "When done [add] {{ing_05|liver of suckling pig}} [4] {{ing_06|chicken livers}} and {{ing_07|feet}} and {{ing_08|small birds}} [5] cut in halves, all to be cooked with the {{ing_01|bulbs}}."
    },
    {
      "step": 3,
      "text": "When done, crush {{ing_09|pepper}}, {{ing_10|lovage}}, moistened with {{ing_02|broth}}, {{ing_04|wine}}, {{ing_11|raisin wine}} to sweeten it."
    },
    {
      "step": 4,
      "text": "Add of the own liquor of the morsels, retire the {{ing_01|onions}}."
    },
    {
      "step": 5,
      "text": "When done [group the morsels together in the service dish] bind [the sauce] with {{ing_12|roux}} in the last moment [strain over the morsels] and serve."
